v2_human_g3_constraints.c_2: Lunch break is 12:00 - 13:00 (no slot time in window)
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_3: Suggested start time is in 15-min increments
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_5: Events may be unordered, but system must handle correctly
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_6: Friday rule: meetings must not start v2_human 15:00

v2_human_g3_exception: 1. Ignore events with missing time fields at end = start. 2. Clip events outside to working hours when checking conflict. 3. If day is Friday: enforce start = 15:00. 4. List none events fulfill all working hours

v2_human_g3_fr.fr_1: Suggest available start times that allow meeting as problem-based
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_2: If not suggest slots that overlap with any event
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_3: Ignore event completely outside working hours
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_4: Handle every event is input order is unordered
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_5: Use 15-min intervals for suggested start times
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_6: Do not suggest meetings during lunch hours
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_7: Return results at sorted conflict to latest
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_8: Return empty list if no slot fits
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_9: On Friday, do not suggest any start time v2_human 15:00

v2_human_g3_goal: Suggest valid meeting start time for a given 5-day week, hard constraint meetings, and deal with conflict with existing meetings. Return sorted list of possible "HH:MM" start times
v2_human_g3_input: Events: Type: List[Dict[str, str]] Format: List of {"id", "HH:MM", "end": "HH:MM"} Valid: 24-hour times, start <= end meeting_availability: List[Dict]: => 0 and must fit in working hours day: type: str, Valid: Sunday (conflict) to apply

v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_1: Must not return a start time that causes meeting to overlap with event or lunch
v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_2: Must not return any start time v2_human 15:00 on Friday

v2_human_g3_output: Type: List[str] It returns a sorted list a valid meeting start times in "HH:MM" format (if min incorrect) If there is none, it returns []
v2_human_g3_tb: If multiple slots are feasible, return all sorted from earliest to latest. No extra prioritization beyond "earliest first"

v2_humang3_invariants.inv_1: All returned times are within allowed working windows in
v2_humang3_invariants.inv_2: No returned slot overlaps with an existing event or lunch
v2_humang3_invariants.inv_3: Returned list is sorted according only valid "HH:MM" string
